# Post-Discharge Transition Plan
**Patient:** 86 y/o | HF (Hypertensive heart disease with heart failure) | Discharged to SNF 10/23/2026 (Friday) | Language: Spanish | Risk Tier: **High (0.32)**

---

**Why this patient is at risk**
High readmission risk driven by no 7-day follow-up booked (status: patient to call), high comorbidity burden, and prior admissions within the last 12 months.

**Within 48 hours**
- Pharmacist med-reconciliation call to SNF (Spanish interpreter required)
- Confirm SNF received complete discharge medication list
- Outreach to patient/SNF to schedule 7-day follow-up (HF Bridge Clinic or PCP)

**Within 7 days**
- Book and confirm 7-day follow-up appointment
- Care-transitions RN check-in call to SNF (Spanish interpreter)
- Verify daily weights and symptom monitoring in place at SNF

**Social needs**
- Spanish-language interpreter for all communications
- Coordinate with SNF care team as primary point of contact

**Teach-back topics**
- Daily weight monitoring and when to alert staff
- Signs/symptoms of worsening HF
- Medication purpose and adherence

---
